methodology_note: Emerging Value v5.0 targets post-rookie NFL development. Years-exp 1-4 are the normal universe; rookies belong to the separate prospect model; Year-5+ players require extraordinary corroborated circumstances. Historical profile is an input, not an action signal. Buy-low market dislocation without a credible current path is WATCHLIST only. Dynasty-stash profiles without a credible current path are WATCHLIST only.
